title: Mystery of the Imperial Capital
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was preparing to set out, news came from the Holy Sect: the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor had formally proposed to the Holy Sect, seeking to marry Chen Nian.

text.content: On the official road, dusk was falling. An inconspicuous carriage moved slowly along the thoroughfare. Chen Ji leaned against the carriage shaft, clutching a bamboo tube he had just taken from a carrier pigeon's leg, his knuckles white from the grip. Inside the bamboo tube was only a thin slip of paper, with four characters that made his heart skip a beat—'Heavenly Fate Still Remains'.

dialogue.content: "Looking at your expression, it seems like good news?" Ye Qing lifted the carriage curtain and crawled out, the Demonic Path's unique cold aura spreading through the cramped cabin. She had changed into Central Plains women's attire today, cyan robes and silk skirts, yet that fierce edge remained impossible to conceal.

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the note into his sleeve, his movements unhurried, as if that momentary loss of composure had never happened. He raised his eyes to look at Ye Qing, his gaze restored to its usual tranquil water, though the corner of his mouth curved with an inexplicable arc: "It's good news, and also bad news."

dialogue.content: "Oh? Do tell." Ye Qing sat down opposite him with great interest, her slender fingers fiddling with a jade pendant carved with a skull pattern at her waist—that was the Holy Sect Saintess's token.

text.content: "My good brother Chen Tianming not only survived, but he's making quite a name for himself in the Imperial Capital." Chen Ji's voice was淡得像在说今日天气，淡得仿佛在谈论 today's weather. " Lurking beside the Crown Prince as a 'Imperial Court Consultant,' tsk, what destiny brings." He paused, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes that even he hadn't noticed.

dialogue.content: "Imperial Court Consultant?" Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly. She wasn't unfamiliar with the Central Plains imperial court's layout, naturally knowing the weight of this title. "Someone who can stand firm beside the Crown Prince is no ordinary person. What do you plan to do? Go find him directly?"

text.content: Chen Ji actually laughed at this, the smile carrying a hint of mockery, but more so an unsettling calculating chill: "Find him? I don't even remember what he looks like anymore. After all those years in that man-eating place called the Imperial Capital, do you think he'd remember he still has a good-for-nothing brother?"

Ye Qing watched him quietly, those eyes that seemed to pierce through hearts reflecting Chen Ji's current outline. She suddenly felt this man before her was very dangerous—even toward his own flesh and blood brother he could maintain such cold judgment, this ruthlessness made even this Demonic Path Saintess inwardly shudder.

"Tell me your analysis." Ye Qing collected her expression. She knew this man needed a listener, not a critic. "What's the current situation within the imperial court? Why would Chen Tianming be discovered by us at this time?"

dialogue.content: "The Crown Prince and Princess's conflict has been brought to the surface." Chen Ji took out a long-yellowed map from his sleeve, covered with密密麻麻 coded information. "The current Emperor is critically ill, with little time left. The Crown Prince governs the state during his regency, yet is hampered at every turn by the Princess—that one's backing is formidable: the Holy Sect."

text.content: When Ye Qing heard the words "Holy Sect," her expression shifted slightly. Chen Ji noticed, the arc of his lips growing increasingly cold: "Interesting, isn't it? The Princess has the Holy Sect behind her, yet an不明来历 consultant appeared beside the Crown Prince. My brother is either a chess piece of the Imperial Court, or..."

dialogue.content: "Or he's a reverse infiltrator?" Ye Qing picked up his words, a flash of appreciation crossing her eyes. "Able to survive in the夹缝 between two major forces, and able to remainendured for so many years—this Chen Tianming... is no simple person."

text.content: Chen Ji folded the map and returned it, his gaze drifting toward the隐约可见 city wall outline in the distance. The Imperial Capital, within sight now. He suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing, what do you think it takes for a person to lurk in the enemy's heart position for a thousand years without being exposed?"

Ye Qingpensive片刻, giving her answer: "Extraordinary strength, or... absolute utility value." Chen Ji nodded upon hearing this, yet a light in his eyes that others couldn't comprehend flashed: "Or perhaps, an identity no one would ever think of."

Just then, the wheels碾过 a stone, the carriageslightly颠簸. Chen Ji seized this间隙 to suddenly speak: "I want to enter the capital as a 'dead man.'" Ye Qingwas momentarily stunned, then understood: "You want everyone to think Chen Ji is already dead?"

dialogue.content: "Only the dead can walk in the shadows." Chen Ji's voice wascalm得可怕, "Chen Ji died three months ago while exploring the Ancient Forbidden Land, his body and bones nowhere to be found. This news—your Holy Sect should have received it too, right?" He looked at Ye Qing, his gaze like a blade.

text.content: Ye Qing slowly nodded, yet her heart was掀起惊涛骇浪. She finally understood how deeply this man before her had strategized—even arranging his own death news in advance, all so he could cut into the chessboard at a critical moment with a brand new identity. This level of scheming made even this Demonic Path Saintess feel ashamed.

"But this path carries enormous risk." Ye Qing gathered her thoughts, restoring her usual composure. "The Imperial Capital's waters run deep. Going in alone, without identity cover, you'll be unable to take a single step. And..." She paused. "Since Chen Tianming can stand firm beside the Crown Prince, with his abilities, he may not fail to察觉 someone lurking in the暗处."

Yet Chen Ji waved it off with a laugh, that smile carrying an elusive confidence: "So what if he察觉? If he truly recognizes this 'good-for-nothing brother,' what do you think he'll do? Kill to keep secrets?" His voice carried a playful tone. "Or perhaps... he also wants to see how far this chess game can go?"

A brief沉默 settled in the carriage. The wheels rolled onward, the Imperial Capital's city gate already隐约可见. Chen Ji suddenly spoke again, his voicelow: "Ye Qing, I need you to do something for me." Ye Qing raised her eyes to look at him, waiting for what came next.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji makes a request to Ye Qing, needing her to cooperate with his layout in the Imperial Capital. Faced with this request, what choice will Ye Qing make?

choices.description: Tell Ye Qing the complete plan, allowing her to cooperate in the open with her identity as the Holy Sect Saintess, forming the closest cooperative relationship between the two.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal more trump cards to allies
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's full support, layout speed in the imperial city doubles
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing betrays, the losses will be severe

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes and slowly opened his mouth: 'I need you to visit the Crown Prince formally, in your capacity as Holy Sect's Saint.' Ye Qing's brow slightly raised, but she didn't interrupt him. Chen Ji continued: 'I want to borrow the Holy Sect's influence to stir up turmoil in the imperial city.'

Ye Qing pondered for a moment, then her lips suddenly curved into an amused smile: 'Are you using the Holy Sect?' Chen Ji shook his head: 'It's mutual benefit. Haven't you always wanted to break free from the Holy Sect's shackles? I can help you.' This sentence precisely struck Ye Qing's weakness.

choices.text: Only reveal part of the plan
choices.description: Only tell Ye Qing the surface plan, let her cooperate with visible matters, while the real core layout is carried out alone.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to obtain all of Ye Qing's resources
choices.visible_reward: Keep the plan secret, even if Ye Qing has problems it won't affect the core layout

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile contained too many things Ye Qing couldn't understand: 'You just need to do one thing - show yourself in front of the Crown Prince, let the people of the dynasty know that the Holy Sect is paying some 'attention' to the Crown Prince.' Ye Qing narrowed her eyes, clearly dissatisfied with this perfunctory answer.

'Is that all?' Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of dissatisfaction, 'You treat me too much as an outsider.' Chen Ji shook his head, his eyes suddenly becoming profound: 'Ye Qing, the less you know, the safer it is for you. This chess game... is far larger than you imagine.'

choices.description: First propose a sensitive question to test Ye Qing's reaction, then decide how much of the plan to reveal based on her answer.
choices.visible_reward: Judge Ye Qing's true stance, decide the depth of subsequent cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Excessive probing will harm the alliance relationship

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly changed the subject: 'Ye Qing, let me ask you something.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'If one day I and the Holy Sect must choose one, which side would you stand on?' This question was too sharp, Ye Qing's face instantly changed.

The atmosphere inside the carriage instantly froze. Ye Qing stared at Chen Ji for a long time, seemingly trying to see something from his eyes. In the end, she spoke: 'Do you know why I'm willing to cooperate with you?' Chen Ji raised his brow, waiting for her to continue.

Ye Qing's answer surprised Chen Ji: 'Because you've never lied to me.' She stood up, walked to the carriage window, lifted the curtain to look at the approaching city gate, 'In the Holy Sect, everyone has eight hundred schemes, ready to sell you for a good price at any moment. But you're different, you see through everything, yet choose to let me decide for myself.'

Chen Ji fell silent. Ye Qing's words made him recall many things - the prophecy on the Tianji Record, that picture only Ye Qing could understand, and her resolute determination to cooperate without hesitation. This woman was far more intelligent than her expression suggested.

'Forget it.' Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carried a kind of desperate resolve, 'Since you're willing to wade through this muddy water, I'll tell you the plan - I want to deal with three forces simultaneously in the imperial city, the Crown Prince, the Princess, and the Holy Sect.' Ye Qing inhaled sharply upon hearing this: 'You're insane?'

dialogue.content: 'I'm not insane.' A terrifying light burned in Chen Ji's eyes, 'Only when three forces stand in opposition can weaknesses emerge, and that's precisely what I seek. As for how to achieve this...' He paused, taking out an ancient token from his chest with a faint, blurred rune etched upon it, 'It all depends on whether they'll take the bait.'

text.content: Ye Qing stared at the token, her pupils suddenly contracting. She recognized that rune - it was a token of the ancient Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, supposedly lost for a thousand years. Where exactly did Chen Ji obtain such a thing? This question churned like a great wave in her heart, but she did not ask it aloud.

The imperial capital's city gate was now close at hand, the majestic city walls resembling a crouching beast, emitting a pressure that could overwhelm the human heart. At the city entrance stretched a long queue, a mixed crowd of various people - merchant traders, officials heading to their posts, and suspicious martial cultivators.

"Chen Ji put down the carriage curtain and said to Ye Qing: 'After entering the city, you take your broad road, and I'll cross my single-plank bridge. If anything happens, use 'Demonic Path Mist' to send a message, and remember... don't expose my identity.' Ye Qing nodded, then suddenly asked: 'Do you trust me that much?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji looked at her, a meaningful glint flashing in his eyes: 'I don't trust you, I only trust interests. You help me because I have what you need—a way to break free from the Holy Sect's control. As long as this premise remains, we're on the same boat.'"

text.content: "Hearing these words, Ye Qing smiled instead. That smile carried a sense of relief: 'You're quite frank.' She took out a black jade talisman from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji, 'This is the catalyst for 'Demonic Path Mist'. If something happens, crush it and I can sense your location.' Chen Ji took the jade talisman and stored it in his chest."

"The carriage stopped at the city gate. Chen Ji lifted the curtain and jumped down. Ye Qing watched his departing figure through the carriage, then suddenly spoke: 'Chen Ji.' Chen Ji's footsteps paused, but he didn't turn around. 'Be careful of your younger brother.' Ye Qing's voice was low, 'Anyone who can survive in the imperial capital isn't simple.'"

"Chen Ji didn't answer, only casually waved his hand before disappearing into the bustling crowd. Ye Qing lowered the carriage curtain, a complex smile curving her lips: 'An interesting fellow...' she murmured, yet her eyes betrayed a trace of concern she herself hadn't noticed."

"Pushing through the bustling crowd, Chen Ji turned and twisted through seven alleyways to reach a secluded narrow lane. At the end of the lane was a dilapidated inn, the characters on its signboard too faded to read clearly, only the words 'Lai Fu' remaining faintly visible. He pushed the door open and entered. Inside, only a few sparse customers were present, and the innkeeper was an unremarkable middle-aged man."

dialogue.content: "The innkeeper's eyes brightened slightly at the sight of Chen Ji, then immediately returned to his drowsy appearance. Chen Ji walked to the counter and lightly knocked three times on the table: 'Chen Ji from the Tianqing Sect, looking to earn a meal.' The innkeeper didn't even lift his eyelids: 'Tianqing Sect? It's been destroyed long ago. You've come to the wrong place.'"

text.content: "Hearing this, the corner of Chen Ji's lips curved even deeper. He took out the inscribed token from his chest and gently placed it on the counter. Upon seeing the token, the innkeeper's turbid old eyes suddenly blazed with brilliant light, his entire person transforming as if replaced, instantly straightening his posture."

dialogue.content: "So it is... Young Master." The innkeeper's voice was pressed extremely low, his attitude reverent and transformed: "This old servant has been awaiting your arrival for so long. Please follow me. Before the master passed away, he left final orders—if one day someone bearing this token arrived, we would spare no effort to assist."

text.content: "Chen Ji put away the token, his expression unchanged: 'Lead the way.' The innkeeper quickly stepped out from behind the counter. Just as he was about to guide Chen Ji toward the back courtyard, Chen Ji suddenly stopped. He tilted his head, seemingly distinguishing some sound. After a moment, he lowered his voice: 'There's a tail. Three people, following me since I entered the city.'"

dialogue.content: "The innkeeper's expression changed: 'Young Master, should this old servant...' Chen Ji raised his hand to stop him, a cold smile curling his lips: 'No need. Let them follow. I want to see who's so bold as to dare track the heir of the Tianji Pavilion.'"

text.content: "Passing through the dim back hall, the innkeeper stopped before what appeared to be an ordinary wall. He pressed his hand on a certain brick, and the wall silently slid open to both sides, revealing a downward staircase. On both walls of the staircase, night pearls that emitted a faint phosphorescent glow were inlaid, with pavilions and structures visible in the depths."

"The Tianji Pavilion on the surface has long been destroyed, but the true core has always been hidden in the dark." The innkeeper explained as he walked, "This is the Tianji Pavilion's intelligence outpost in the imperial capital. The master... that is, your master Chen Xuan, arranged countless hidden pieces before his death, only waiting for someone with fate to activate them."

"Following the innkeeper into the underground palace-like complex of structures, Chen Ji was secretly astonished inside. The scale here far exceeded his imagination—various intelligence networks, contact codes, and information on undercover personnel were all present. He suddenly understood master Chen Xuan's profound foresight—this old man had been paving the way for him from the very beginning."

choice.prompt: "Faced with the vast resources left behind by the Tianji Pavilion, Chen Ji needed to make a choice regarding how to utilize these hidden pieces. Which strategy do you hope he adopts?"

choices.description: "Immediately activate all hidden pieces to establish an intelligence network in the imperial capital at the fastest speed, showcasing the protagonist's control."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain complete intelligence network support, greatly accelerating the pace of imperial capital layout"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood in the center of the underground palace's grand hall, surveying his surroundings. Countless intelligence files were displayed here, each representing a hidden connection. He took a deep breath and spoke: 'Gather everyone. From today forward, I officially take over all of the Tianji Pavilion's power in the imperial capital.'"

choices.description: "First activate only some hidden pieces, personally screen usable personnel, avoid being misled by any chess game within the game Chen Xuan may have left behind."

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to make a decision. Instead, he turned to the shopkeeper: 'First show me the list of these undercover agents. I will screen them personally.' The shopkeeper hesitated briefly, then showed an appreciative expression: 'Young Master is indeed prudent. Among these undercover agents, some are indeed... not entirely reliable.'

choices.description: Temporarily do not activate any undercover agents. Only use the intelligence facilities here to observe the capital's situation before making decisions.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute secrecy, even if failing does not expose the existence of Tianji Pavilion

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then shook his head: 'For now, do not alert them.' The shopkeeper's expression slightly changed: 'What does the Young Master mean...' Chen Ji said coolly: 'I want to see how deep this water is first. These undercover agents have been here for so many years, who knows if they've been infiltrated? Let's use your intelligence network to observe the situation first, without startling the snakes.'

The shopkeeper, upon hearing this, had a flash of appreciation in his eyes: 'Young Master thinks thoroughly, truly a great fortune.' He took out a jade slip from his chest and handed it to Chen Ji: 'This is the distribution map of the various factions in the capital, along with recent intelligence trends. Please review it, Young Master.' Chen Ji took the jade slip, and his spiritual sense probed into it, vast amounts of information instantly flooding his mind.

After a moment, Chen Ji withdrew his spiritual sense, his brow slightly furrowed. The intelligence in the jade slip gave him a clearer understanding of the capital's situation—the struggle between the Crown Prince and Princess had reached a white-hot stage, and Chen Tianming's identity was indeed as Ye Qing had said, a close confidant of the Crown Prince. But what caught his attention even more was another piece of intelligence: the Holy Sect had been unusually active in the capital recently, seemingly scheming something significant.

There is one more thing.' The shopkeeper's voice interrupted Chen Ji's thoughts. 'According to our undercover agent planted in the Crown Prince's residence, three days ago, the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor personally wrote a secret letter to the Holy Sect. The letter's contents are unknown, but from our speculation... it likely concerns a marriage alliance.'

Marriage alliance?' Chen Ji's heart sank abruptly, an ominous premonition rising in his heart. He immediately pressed: 'Who is the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor seeking to marry?' The shopkeeper shook his head: 'This... we don't have confirmed information yet. But according to our undercover agent's report, the Holy Sect reacted intensely after receiving the letter, seemingly...' He paused, 'seemingly very troubled.'

A sudden thought flashed through Chen Ji's mind, a thought that nearly froze his blood. Chen Nian! His younger sister, taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' Chen Nian! If the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor was seeking her hand in marriage... An unprecedented fury burned in his chest, but he forcibly suppressed it.

dialogue.content: Investigate! Investigate thoroughly!' Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold and sharp. The shopkeeper had never seen this new master lose composure so drastically, and couldn't help but shudder. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来: 'At any cost, I must know the complete contents of that letter.'

text.content: At this moment, a slight vibration suddenly came from somewhere in the underground palace. The shopkeeper's expression changed drastically: 'Bad! Someone has triggered the outer forbidden formations!' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his mind racing rapidly. For the formations here to vibrate, it meant the intruder was not weak—or there were many of them.

Are those three tails?' Chen Ji asked. The shopkeeper shook his head: 'Highly unlikely. This hideout is extremely well-hidden. Ordinary people couldn't find it at all. To trigger the formations... one would need at least Golden Core stage or above.' Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips instead curved into a cold smile: 'Interesting, it seems my brother is more sharp-witted than I imagined.'

choice.prompt: Facing a possible enemy attack, Chen Ji must make a choice: to fight, retreat, or have other plans?

choices.description: Since the enemy has come looking, might as well take advantage of the situation, establish prestige in the heart of the capital, display strength to deter the riffraff.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some strength, possibly attracting more attention
choices.visible_reward: Make a name in the capital, attract the attention of various factions
choices.risk_hint: May expose identity, bringing bigger troubles

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his aura suddenly soaring. Although he had always presented himself as a waste, the Tianji Record Fragment had never stopped enhancing his cultivation—moreover, he had many hidden trump cards unknown to others. 'Since you're here, then don't leave.' His voice was cold as the icy wind of the Nine Netherworlds.

choices.description: Do not engage the enemy head-on, use Tianji Pavilion's secret passages to retreat, avoiding exposing himself too early.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute secrecy to buy time for subsequent布局

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "There's no need to waste energy here." The shopkeeper hastily opened a hidden passage: "Young master, please follow me. This leads to a safe house outside the city." Chen Ji cast one final glance at the underground palace, then turned and entered the secret passage.

choices.description: Proactively reveal our identity to the enemy, lure the snake out of its hole, and see who's pulling the strings behind the scenes.
choices.visible_reward: See through the enemy's底牌, seize the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly changed his mind. He said to the shopkeeper: "Issue the order, activate the 'Lure the Snake Out' plan." The shopkeeper's eyes lit up: "Young master intends to..." A meaningful smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: "Since they're looking for me, I'll let them find me—except, what they'll find is the person they want to find."

The safe house outside the city was an unremarkable farmhouse, surrounded by ordinary crops. Without guidance, one would never discover anything unusual here. Chen Ji stood by the window, gazing at the majestic walls of the imperial city in the distance, his brow furrowed. The Crown Prince Tutor's marriage proposal, the Holy Sect's machinations, Chen Tianming's sudden appearance... none of this was coincidence.

"Chen Nian..." Chen Ji whispered her name, a tenderness flickering in his eyes that even he hadn't noticed. His sister, missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"—if she were truly caught up in this imperial struggle... he would never allow it.

Just then, the black jade symbol against his chest suddenly grew warm—a transmission through Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mists." Chen Ji retrieved the token, information flooding his mind: the Holy Sect had formally responded to the Crown Prince Tutor's marriage proposal, agreeing to the betrothal. In three days, the engagement ceremony would be held in the imperial city.

Chen Ji's hand tightened violently around the jade token, his knuckles cracking from the force. Three days... he only had three days. The imperial city's chess game had just begun, yet his sister was about to be traded as a bargaining chip in marriage. Was this the Holy Sect's decision, or was someone manipulating everything from the shadows?

He took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来. Anger solved nothing—he needed strategy, just as he had always done, weaving an unbreakable game from the shadows. But this time, the most important person stood on his chessboard. He could no longer stay hidden.

Outside the window, night deepened. In the direction of the imperial city, lights shone brilliantly, music and dancing prevailed, entirely unaware that a storm was about to arrive. Chen Ji turned and walked to the desk, spreading a blank sheet of paper, dipping his brush in ink. He was going to write a letter—one powerful enough to stir the winds and clouds of the imperial city. "Chen Tianming..." he murmured, "Brother, it's time for you to make your choice."
